The response also labels a facilitated visa regime, but that label does not by itself identify a tourist eVisa route and is not normalized here.

policies.title: Namibian citizen: outside foreign-visitor visa requirement
policies.summary: The Immigration Control Act's ordinary entry rule expressly excepts a person proved to be a Namibian citizen from the foreign-visa requirement.
conditions: This classification only records the statutory exception to the foreign-visitor visa requirement. It does not decide documentary proof, a dual national travelling on another passport, departure controls, security screening or individual admission matters.
The Act permits the Minister to make or withdraw category exemptions and does not displace other immigration-control powers.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa-free holiday visitors
policies.summary: The current MHAISS Visa Fact Sheet expressly places this all-passport cohort on its holiday visa-exemption list under the 1 April 2025 reciprocity framework.
conditions: The fact sheet describes this as holiday travel and lists all passport types; this policy only normalizes the catalog's ordinary passports. It establishes neither work, residence, business-only, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee nor other special-document treatment.

A visitor permit issued at entry may not exceed 90 days in a calendar year. The FAQ requires a valid passport (normally six months; two clean pages for the general tourist list), accommodation or invitation evidence, funds, itinerary/onward evidence, insurance and any child documents; admission remains discretionary.
The online Visa-on-Arrival portal may offer a voluntary application to an otherwise exempt traveller. It is not a required ETA or visa and does not displace this direct exemption.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: MHAISS's current named schedule says this cohort may obtain a visa on arrival, while allowing an optional pre-departure eVisa. Because a border-issuance route is directly available, it is normalized as visa_on_arrival rather than evisa.
conditions: This is the MHAISS named non-exempt cohort. It can obtain an arrival visa or, optionally, an eVisa before travel; the latter optional alternative does not convert the direct arrival route into evisa for this taxonomy.

The visitor route is for holiday/tourist travel. The FAQ sets a visitor-entry permit ceiling of 90 days in each calendar year, allows an extension application before expiry, and requires the ordinary visitor documents, funds, accommodation/invitation, onward itinerary and insurance. A VOA applicant needs a passport valid at least six months and three clean pages.

VOA is only at designated ports. The FAQ lists Hosea Kutako airport, Ariamsvlei, Impalila, Katima Mulilo, Mohembo, Ngoma, Noordoewer, Oshikango, Oranjemund, Trans-Kalahari, Walvis Bay Harbour and Walvis Bay airport; Version 4 additionally lists Lüderitz Harbour. Recheck the operating port because current MHAISS documents disagree on that port.

The September notice said the pre-existing manual VOA fee was N$1,600 and approved an additional N$400, with implementation of the increase to be announced. Fees, security/admissibility and border-officer decisions remain variable. Work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are excluded.

application.label: Namibia online Visa-on-Arrival application
application.processingTime: The current FAQ says an online Visa-on-Arrival application takes 48 hours; an application may also be completed on arrival at a listed port.
steps: Use the MHAISS e-services route before departure if choosing the optional online Visa-on-Arrival process, or complete the arrival application at a designated port.
Present the required passport, supporting visitor documents and any approved/printed document requested by immigration.
Obtain the visa and visitor-entry permission from the immigration officer; approval or application does not guarantee admission.

policies.title: Approved September 2025 additional ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: MHAISS's approved 23 September 2025 notice expressly adds this catalog cohort to Visa-on-Arrival eligibility at designated ports. Its online e-services reference is an application for VOA, not proof of an electronically issued advance visa.
conditions: The official additional-country notice says these nationals are now eligible to obtain visas on arrival at designated ports and directs them to the e-services portal for an optional VOA application. It therefore does not establish an ETA or a mandatory pre-travel eVisa.

The FAQ visitor requirements, 90-days-in-a-calendar-year visitor-permit cap, extension-before-expiry procedure, six-month passport validity and three clean VOA passport pages apply. Carry accommodation/invitation, funds, itinerary/onward evidence, insurance and child documentation as applicable.

VOA is only at designated ports; the FAQ and Version 4 differ about whether Lüderitz Harbour is in the current set, so travellers must check the operating port. Fees were announced as subject to a later implementation notice. This excludes work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes.

application.label: Namibia online Visa-on-Arrival application
application.processingTime: The FAQ describes a 48-hour online Visa-on-Arrival application, while the notice also preserves issuance on arrival at designated ports.
steps: Choose the MHAISS online VOA application before travel or apply manually on arrival at a designated port.
Bring the required passport, supporting visitor evidence and any printed approval requested at the border.
Receive the actual visa and visitor-entry permission from immigration; entry is subject to officer assessment.

policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: mandatory pre-travel eVisa
policies.summary: The current MHAISS fact sheet supplies an explicit default: a passport absent from every exemption and VOA list cannot use VOA and must obtain an eVisa before travel. This is an exhaustive official complement, not inference from silence.
conditions: This residual cohort is defined only by the fact sheet's exhaustive rule: it is not on any listed exemption or VOA list, cannot apply for VOA, and must obtain an eVisa before travel. It does not support a consular-visa, VOA, ETA or visa-free alternative.

The FAQ says online visa processing is five business days and an approved eVisa must be printed for the immigration officer. The visitor permit at entry may not exceed 90 days in a calendar year; extensions are requested before expiry.

Use only gazetted entry ports and carry the general visitor passport, accommodation/invitation, funds, itinerary/onward, insurance and child documents. Work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and special-document routes are outside this ordinary visitor policy; all admission remains discretionary.

application.label: Namibia MHAISS e-services visa application
application.processingTime: The current FAQ says an online visa takes five business days; allow extra time because MHAISS may require documents or further assessment.
steps: Obtain the required eVisa through MHAISS before travelling; this cohort cannot wait to apply for a visa on arrival.
Submit the passport and supporting visitor documentation and retain the approval for travel.
Print the approved eVisa and present it with the required documents at an authorised port; entry remains subject to immigration assessment.

policies.title: Category A ordinary passports: Zimbabwe visa-free visitors
policies.summary: The Department of Immigration Category A schedule and the live official eVisa nationality regime both expressly place this ordinary-passport cohort in the no-visa visitor category.
conditions: The schedules concern country nationals visiting Zimbabwe; this policy does not establish work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee or other special-document treatment.
The online Zimbabwe Entry Declaration may be pre-filled before travel, but both official pages describe it as an entry declaration and it is not normalized as an ETA or visa.

Entry remains subject to ordinary documentary, health, security and immigration examination. The listed sources do not state a universal visitor stay period, proof-of-funds rule, accommodation rule or extension rule for this visa-free cohort.

policies.title: Zambian ordinary passport: Zimbabwe Category A visa-free visitor
policies.summary: Zimbabwe Immigration's current Category A schedule expressly names Zambia. The live eVisa FAQ omits it, so this narrow policy is retained separately with medium confidence rather than treated as a schedule complement.
conditions: This is a narrow ordinary-passport visitor finding from the Department of Immigration's Category A page. The official eVisa FAQ omission is a mutable-source discrepancy, not evidence of a different route.

The Entry Declaration is an optional/pre-fillable processing form, not an ETA or visa. Work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this policy.
Entry remains subject to documentary, health, security and immigration examination; the cited schedule does not state a universal stay, funds, accommodation or extension rule.

policies.title: Category B ordinary passports: Zimbabwe paid visa on arrival
policies.summary: The live official eVisa regime expressly allows this cohort to pay for and obtain a visa upon entering Zimbabwe. The optional online application does not displace that easier arrival route.
conditions: Category B requires a visa, but the official pages expressly permit payment and issuance at a Zimbabwe port of entry. This is therefore visa_on_arrival, even though an applicant may instead apply online before travel.

The current portal describes a standard arrival visa as valid for one month; double-entry and multiple-entry options have separate stated validity. Multiple-entry arrival availability is expressly limited to UK, US and Canadian travellers.

The Entry Declaration can be pre-filled online but is not an ETA. Visa type, fee and admission remain subject to Immigration's processing and discretion; no business-only, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document route is included.

policies.title: Category C ordinary passports: Zimbabwe advance electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: The official Category C and eVisa regime require this cohort to apply, pay and obtain approval before travel. Immigration describes the approval as electronically issued and emailed, so it is normalized as evisa rather than visa required.
conditions: This policy covers only the named Category C ordinary-passport visitor cohort. The eVisa confirmation is issued electronically and emailed; passport stamping on arrival does not convert it into visa on arrival.

The official portal says to apply at least three weeks before travel and describes eVisa validity from issue as one month single-entry, three months double-entry, or six months multiple-entry. Processing or payment does not guarantee approval or admission.

The Entry Declaration is separate from the eVisa. Work, residence, business-only, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and special-document rules remain outside this baseline; entry is subject to security and Immigration discretion.

application.label: Zimbabwe Department of Immigration eVisa service
application.processingTime: The FAQ states an average processing time of seven working days and advises applying at least three weeks before travel.
steps: Use the official Zimbabwe eVisa service to submit the visa application, required documents and payment before travel.
Wait for the electronic approval/confirmation sent to the applicant's email; an application fee does not guarantee approval.
Print the approved eVisa for travel and present it with the required travel documents for Immigration examination and passport stamping on arrival.

policies.title: Zimbabwean citizens: constitutional right to enter Zimbabwe
policies.summary: The Constitution grants every Zimbabwean citizen the right to enter Zimbabwe, so a Zimbabwean ordinary passport holder is not classified under the foreign-visitor visa regime.
conditions: This records the constitutional citizen-entry right only. It does not model nationality acquisition, dual-nationality disputes, passport issuance, document validity, criminal process, customs, health, security screening or other border controls.

policies.title: Kenyan and Djiboutian ordinary passports: Ethiopia visa-free tourist entry
policies.summary: The live official eVisa arrival page expressly says Kenyan and Djiboutian citizens holding a valid passport can enter Ethiopia without a visa. This narrower express exemption takes precedence over those codes also appearing in the mutable arrival table.
conditions: The page requires a valid passport. It does not state a stay limit, entry count, operating port, fee, onward-ticket, funds, accommodation, vaccination or extension rule for this exemption.

This finding is limited to the named ordinary-passport visitor nationality rule. It does not decide African Union, diplomatic, official, service, residence, work, business, transit, Ethiopian-origin card, refugee, special-document or individual-admissibility treatment.
Border admission remains subject to immigration and security examination; the current eVisa general guidance reserves officials' right to deny entry.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Ethiopia tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current official eVisa service renders this exhaustive named tourist cohort with the category Visa on Arrival. The portal separately offers an online tourist visa, but an express arrival route is the easier baseline and is normalized as visa_on_arrival.
conditions: This is the official portal's current named tourist Visa-on-Arrival schedule. It does not state a universal visa-on-arrival duration, fee, passport-validity, onward-ticket, funds, accommodation, vaccination, extension, transit or work rule.

The live direct source does not identify the operating port or expressly confirm Addis Ababa Bole Airport. Accordingly this candidate records a route-limited arrival authorization but does not generalize it to every Ethiopian border or airport.

The current eVisa general information says entry officers may deny admission. Residence, business, employment, conference, study, transit, diplomatic, official, service, Ethiopian-origin and other special-document routes are outside this baseline.

policies.title: Other ordinary passports: Ethiopia electronic single-entry tourist visa
policies.summary: The official Tourist Visa page expressly makes citizens of all countries eligible and calls the visitor authorization an electronic single-entry visa. The named visa-free and visa-on-arrival cohorts are removed because they have an easier direct route; the remaining ordinary passports are therefore evisa, not an inferred consular-visa complement.
conditions: This is tourism or other non-business travel only. It is electronic and single-entry; the official page lists 30-day and 90-day maximum-duration products, and says normal processing is three days with application at least three days before expected arrival.

A recent passport photo and a passport valid at least six months from intended entry are stated requirements. The official guidance gives fees of USD 62 for 30 days and USD 152 for 90 days, with later extension procedures and overstay penalties.

The portal's global eligibility statement is explicit. Separately, it says it does not accept credit-card transactions from AF, CU, IQ, SD, SY and YE (as well as three codes already covered by the easier arrival schedule). This is retained as a material payment/access condition rather than silently reclassifying the passports as advance-visa or unresolved.

The portal says entry may be refused even to an eVisa holder. This baseline does not decide business, work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, Ethiopian-origin, refugee, special-document, health or case-specific security/admissibility rules.

application.label: Ethiopian Government eVisa service
application.processingTime: The Tourist Visa page states normal processing is three days and advises applying at least three days before estimated arrival.
steps: Use the Ethiopian Government eVisa service and choose the tourist visa for tourism or other non-business travel.
Provide the required recent photo and passport that is valid at least six months from intended entry, then complete the portal's payment and application process.
Obtain approval before travel and present the approved eVisa and travel documents for immigration examination at entry.

policies.title: Ethiopian citizens: constitutional right to return
policies.summary: The Constitution directly grants Ethiopian nationals the right to return to Ethiopia, so the same-country ordinary-passport pair is not classified under the foreign tourist visa system.
conditions: This records the constitutional citizen return right only. It does not decide passport issuance or validity, dual nationality, document checks, health, customs, criminal process, security screening or other border formalities.

policies.title: Ghana: ECOWAS ordinary passports — visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The live official eVisa checker returns no authorization for this complete named ECOWAS cohort. This is normalized as visa-free admission, not ETA, because its response expressly says neither visa nor ETA is required.
conditions: The live checker returns ECOWAS/AES, no authorization, 90 days, multiple entry, no application and no fee. The eVisa result is the current operational source; it agrees with the statutory ECOWAS exception and the Embassy's named ECOWAS list.

This policy is limited to ordinary-passport short visits and does not decide work, residence, study, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document, border-pass, health, security, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Carry a valid travel document and satisfy any current yellow-fever, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, border examination and other admission conditions.

policies.title: Ghana: non-ECOWAS African ordinary passports — advance ETA
policies.summary: For this complete African Union ordinary-passport cohort outside ECOWAS and Ghanaian citizenship, the live official checker returns an advance Electronic Travel Authorization rather than visa-free admission or a visa on arrival.

The April MFA waiver table pre-dates the May eVisa launch and lists several of these passports as visa-free; the current operational checker is followed for the required authorization. This dated inter-source discrepancy is a material recheck risk.

The portal's tourist eVisa requirements require a passport valid six months beyond intended stay; yellow-fever evidence, itinerary/accommodation, purpose, security and admission requirements remain applicable. No work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service or special-document route is decided.

policies.title: Ghana: named Caribbean ordinary passports — advance ETA
policies.summary: The live official checker expressly labels these ten passports Caribbean visa-waiver countries but requires an ETA before travel; the authorization is not a visa-free classification.
conditions: The live checker returns Caribbean, ETA required, 90 days and single entry. The stated message calls these Caribbean visa-waiver countries, but its required ETA controls the normalized route.

conditions: The official checker returns Asian visa-waiver country, ETA required, 90 days and single entry. The authorization must be obtained before travel even though no visa fee is stated.
